/*
 * Do not modify every AdSense <ins>. Auto ads and vignette overlays use their
 * own transforms for viewport centring. A broad transform:none shifts and clips
 * those overlays, especially on mobile. Also undo the global stable scrollbar
 * gutter while a vignette is open, because Google sizes it to the visual viewport.
 */

Ondas Shares Drop 4.7% Before Market Open as Aran Agreement Prices Revenue at 1.9x Sales        </a></h2><div class="meta56 component56"><div class="meta56__item meta56__date" title="18 Aug, 2026 12:05:55">

Shares of Ondas Inc. declined 4.7% to $8.58 during premarket trading on Tuesday, after the company announced an all-stock deal worth $33.9 million to acquire Aran Defense. 			function pushAd(ins){
				try {
					if (!ins) return;
					if (ins.getAttribute('data-adsbygoogle-status')) return;
					if (ins.getAttribute('data-ts2-sidebar-pushed')) return;

					ins.setAttribute('data-ts2-sidebar-pushed', '1');
					window.adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || [];
					window.adsbygoogle.push({});
				} catch(e) {}
			}

			function isDesktop(){
				return !(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1024px)').matches);
			}

			function initSidebarAds(){
				try {
					if (!isDesktop()) return;

					var ads = document.querySelectorAll('ins.adsbygoogle.ts2-sidebar-adsbygoogle');
					if (!ads || !ads.length) return;

					if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
						for (var i = 0; i < ads.length; i++) pushAd(ads[i]);
						return;
					}

					var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries, observer){
						for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
							if (entries[i].isIntersecting) {
								pushAd(entries[i].target);
								observer.unobserve(entries[i].target);
							}
						}
					}, {
						root:null,
						rootMargin:'500px 0px 500px 0px',
						threshold:0.01
					});

					for (var j = 0; j < ads.length; j++) {
						var r = ads[j].getBoundingClientRect();

						if (r && r.bottom > -50 && r.top < (window.innerHeight + 50)) {
							pushAd(ads[j]);
						} else {
							obs.observe(ads[j]);
						}
					}
				} catch(e) {}
			}

			if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
				document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSidebarAds);
			} else {
				initSidebarAds();
			}
		})();</script> <style id="ts2-home-video-thumbs-css">.thumbnail56.ts2-home-video-ready {

			}</style> <script data-cfasync="false" id="ts2-home-video-thumbs-js">(function(){
            var AJAX_URL = "https:\/\/ts2.tech\/wp-admin\/admin-ajax.php";
            var ACTION = "ts2_home_video_thumbs_get";
            var MAX_IDS = 40;
            var requested = false;
            var inFlight = false;

            function getContentRoot() {
                // Keep this plugin away from sidebar/widgets. Theme class names differ,
                // so we try common main-content containers and fall back to document.
                return document.querySelector("main") ||
                    document.querySelector("#main") ||
                    document.querySelector(".site-main") ||
                    document.querySelector(".content-area") ||
                    document.querySelector(".main-content") ||
                    document;
            }

            function isInSidebarOrWidget(article) {
                return !!article.closest("aside, #secondary, .sidebar, .widget, .widget-area, .ts2-sidebar-youtube-videos");
            }

            function shouldSkipArticle(article) {
                return isInSidebarOrWidget(article) ||
                    article.closest(".sectionlist--widget56--id--2") ||
                    article.classList.contains("post56--ontop") ||
                    article.querySelector(".post56__overlay") ||
                    article.querySelector(".post56__wraplink") ||
                    article.closest(".carousel56");
            }

            function collectPostIds() {
                var ids = [];
                var seen = {};
                var root = getContentRoot();

                root.querySelectorAll("article[class*='post-']").forEach(function(article) {
                    if (ids.length >= MAX_IDS) return;

                    var m = article.className.match(/(?:^|\s)post-(\d+)(?:\s|$)/);
                    if (!m) return;

                    var id = m[1];
                    if (seen[id]) return;
                    if (!article.querySelector("figure.thumbnail56")) return;
                    if (shouldSkipArticle(article)) return;

                    seen[id] = true;
                    ids.push(id);
                });

                return ids;
            }

            function getArticleTitle(article) {
                var titleLink = article.querySelector(".title56 a");
                var title = titleLink ? (titleLink.textContent || "").trim() : "";

                if (!title) {
                    var image = article.querySelector("figure.thumbnail56 img[alt]");
                    title = image ? (image.getAttribute("alt") || "").trim() : "";
                }

                return title;
            }

            function fixDiscernibleLinks() {
                document.querySelectorAll("article.post56 a.post56__wraplink").forEach(function(link) {
                    if ((link.textContent || "").trim() || link.getAttribute("aria-label")) return;

                    var article = link.closest("article.post56");
                    var title = article ? getArticleTitle(article) : "";
                    link.setAttribute("aria-label", title ? "Read: " + title : "Read article");
                });
            }

            function replaceThumbs(videos) {
                Object.keys(videos || {}).forEach(function(postId) {
                    getContentRoot().querySelectorAll("article.post-" + postId).forEach(function(article) {
                        if (shouldSkipArticle(article)) return;

                        var figure = article.querySelector("figure.thumbnail56");
                        if (!figure || figure.classList.contains("ts2-home-video-ready")) return;

                        var item = videos[postId];
                        if (!item || !item.embed || !item.thumb) return;

                        var oldImage = figure.querySelector("img");
                        var oldMedia = figure.querySelector("img, .imageframe56");
                        var rect = oldMedia ? oldMedia.getBoundingClientRect() : figure.getBoundingClientRect();
                        var h = Math.round(rect.height || 0);
                        var w = Math.round(rect.width || 0);

                        if (h < 50 && w > 0) {
                            h = Math.round(w * 0.5625);
                        }

                        var btn = document.createElement("button");
                        btn.type = "button";
                        btn.className = "ts2-home-video-lite";
                        btn.setAttribute("data-youtube-src", item.embed);
                        var articleTitle = getArticleTitle(article);
                        btn.setAttribute("aria-label", articleTitle ? "Play video: " + articleTitle : "Play YouTube video");

                        if (h > 0) {
                            btn.style.height = h + "px";
                            btn.style.minHeight = h + "px";
                        }

                        var img = document.createElement("img");
                        var existingSrc = oldImage ? (oldImage.currentSrc || oldImage.getAttribute("src") || "") : "";
                        img.src = existingSrc || item.thumb;
                        img.alt = oldImage ? (oldImage.getAttribute("alt") || "") : "";
                        img.decoding = "async";

                        /*
                         * All above-the-fold cards are skipped. Replacements therefore
                         * stay low priority and cannot compete with the real LCP image.
                         */
                        img.loading = "lazy";
                        img.setAttribute("fetchpriority", "low");

                        if (oldImage) {
                            ["width", "height", "srcset", "sizes", "title"].forEach(function(attribute) {
                                var value = oldImage.getAttribute(attribute);
                                if (value) img.setAttribute(attribute, value);
                            });
                        }

                        var play = document.createElement("span");
                        play.className = "ts2-home-video-play";
                        play.textContent = "▶";

                        btn.appendChild(img);
                        btn.appendChild(play);

                        figure.innerHTML = "";
                        figure.appendChild(btn);
                        figure.classList.add("ts2-home-video-ready");
                    });
                });
            }

            function loadVideos() {
                if (requested || inFlight) return;

                var ids = collectPostIds();
                if (!ids.length) return;

                requested = true;
                inFlight = true;

                var body = new URLSearchParams();
                body.append("action", ACTION);
                body.append("ids", ids.join(","));

                fetch(AJAX_URL, {
                    method: "POST",
                    credentials: "same-origin",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8"
                    },
                    body: body.toString()
                })
                .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
                .then(function(json){
                    if (!json || !json.success || !json.data) return;
                    replaceThumbs(json.data);
                })
                .catch(function(){})
                .finally(function(){ inFlight = false; });
            }

            document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
                var btn = e.target.closest(".ts2-home-video-lite");
                if (!btn) return;

                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();

                var src = btn.getAttribute("data-youtube-src");
                if (!src) return;

                var h = btn.offsetHeight || 180;

                var iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
                iframe.src = src + "?autoplay=1&rel=0";
                iframe.title = "YouTube Video";
                iframe.allow = "accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share";
                iframe.allowFullscreen = true;

                var wrap = document.createElement("div");
                wrap.className = "ts2-home-video-frame";
                wrap.style.height = h + "px";
                wrap.style.minHeight = h + "px";
                wrap.appendChild(iframe);

                btn.replaceWith(wrap);
            }, true);

            function scheduleVideoLoad() {
                var run = function() { loadVideos(); };

                if ("requestIdleCallback" in window) {
                    window.requestIdleCallback(run, { timeout: 2000 });
                } else {
                    window.setTimeout(run, 700);
                }
            }

            function init() {
                fixDiscernibleLinks();

                if (document.readyState === "complete") {
                    scheduleVideoLoad();
                } else {
                    window.addEventListener("load", scheduleVideoLoad, { once: true });
                }
            }

            if (document.readyState === "loading") {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init, { once: true });
            } else {
                init();
            }

		done = true;
		fn();
	};
